mapper.select:
select p.id, p.user_id, p.content, p.image, p.like_count, p.create_time, p.update_time,
case when l.id is not null then true else false end as liked
false as liked
from tb_post p
left join tb_post_like l on p.id = l.post_id and l.user_id = #{userId}
order by p.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into tb_post (user_id, content, image, like_count) values (#{userId}, #{content}, #{image}, #{likeCount})
mapper.update: update tb_post set like_count = case when like_count > 0 then like_count - 1 else 0 end where id = #{id}
